name: Animals and Husbandry
description: Animal Husbandry makes farm animals feel alive.

pages.title: Animals and Husbandry
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Animals have hunger, cleanliness, happiness, health and traits. Care changes what you get.
- Check them in the **Farm Ledger**.
- Brush them for happiness; sick ones need Animal Medicine.
- Genes pass on traits, like Heavyweight's double meat.
**Animal Husbandry** makes farm animals feel alive. Each has hunger, cleanliness, happiness, health and inherited traits. Care changes what you get.

pages.title: Farm Ledger
pages.text: Tracks hunger, cleanliness, growth, yield, fertility and happiness. The [Farm Magnifying Glass](item://animalhusbandry:magnifying_glass) inspects one animal: sickness, cooldowns, wool and milk.

pages.title: Grooming
pages.text: Brush animals to raise **happiness**. Feeding Troughs hold feed, Brushing Posts help with grooming, and sick animals need [Animal Medicine](item://animalhusbandry:animal_medicine). A Fertility Potion readies a pair to mate.

Traits come from genes:

- A **Glutton** grows fast.
- A **Truffle Snout** finds more truffles.
- A **Heavyweight** drops double meat and leather.

Look at an animal in the ledger to see what it has.

pages.title: Eggs and Cheese
pages.text: Chicken Nests hold eggs. Milk in a cauldron becomes cheese blocks and slices. Pigs with the right trait dig up truffles. Either truffle (this one or Fungi Delight's) works in Animal Medicine and in Fungi Delight dishes.

Create tie-ins: Roosts and Fishing Nets from [#](2E5AAC)[Integrated Farming](entry://food/integrated_farming)[#]() handle poultry on contraptions, and [#](2E5AAC)[Ratatouille](entry://food/ratatouille)[#]()'s Spreader breeds animals.\
\
Bees: [#](2E5AAC)[Productive Bees](entry://food/bees)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The pack runs Animal Husbandry 0.4.2, so there are no rabbit genetics or Angora armor.\
\
Wild animals never get hungry or sick. Care needs start once an animal is domesticated.\
\
Breeding is not instant: the mother carries the young for 3 days (cow), 2 days (sheep, goat) or 1.5 days (pig) before it is born.

Other animal mods:

- **Critters and Companions** adds small creatures like red pandas, ferrets, koi and dragonflies. Its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny spawns are off.
- **Naturalist** adds bears, deer, elephants, lions and more. Nine of its sea animals are off; see [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Life](entry://ocean/sea_life)[#]().
- **Sniffers Sniff Delights** gives sniffers a job: see [#](2E5AAC)[Delight Add-ons](entry://food/farmers_delight_addons)[#]().
